messages:
mina-sales: Prep for client call tomorrow at 09:00. Requirements: strict EU processing, BYOK, signed subprocessor attestation, and a deterministic routing policy with no cross-border failover. Need a two-sentence script + quick ops checklist.

raj-presales: TL;DR: Hosted = EU-preferred only; Dedicated/Private = can be pinned and BYOK supported.

ela-eng: Hosted note: preference not hard-guaranteed under capacity/DR. Dedicated: single-region reserved pool (eu-west1 or eu-central1) with regional-only routing. Private: full customer control. BYOK onboarding includes key exchange, policy validation, and test decrypts.

sam-legal: EU subprocessors we use: LogSafe (logs), Observr (metrics), CloudGX (infra). We can provide DPA, subprocessor list, SOC2 and signed attestation on request. Avoid absolutes for Hosted.

mina-sales: Two conservative lines I can read?

ela-eng: Hosted (conservative): "Redwood processes customer workloads primarily in EU regions; in rare capacity or recovery events requests may be routed to a compatible region; Redwood will notify the customer and propose mitigation."

ela-eng: Dedicated (conservative): "Redwood will provision dedicated capacity in the customer-specified EU region and operate with regional-only routing; processing and stored customer data will remain in that region except for minimal control-plane metadata required for platform operation and auditing."

ivy-ops: Ops checklist (ticket PROJ-90011): 1) Confirm exact EU region choice 2) Collect KMS key ID, rotation policy, and allowlist CIDRs 3) Deliver signed subprocessor attestation + DPA timeline 4) Agree on egress cert fingerprints & rotation cadence 5) Audit log export cadence and retention 6) SLA, failure modes, and runbook. I'll open PROJ-90011.

ton y-pricing: Ballpark for procurement: one-time onboarding/setup ~$38k, committed monthly for 2x A100 dedicated pool ~$17.5k/mo, BYOK & attestation add-on ~$5k/yr. Final depends on throughput/retention.

ops-bot: Ticket PROJ-90011 created and assigned to @ivy-ops.

mina-sales: Great  I'll use the lines + pricing and promise PROJ-90011 follow-up. Will post redlines after the call. :thumbsup:
